product.name: QTRX-HD-15A Reflectance Sensor Array: 15-Channel, 4mm Pitch, Analog Output, Low Current

warnings: The 61 mm length, 20 mm width and 4 mm sensor pitch are printed in the dimension image. The 3 mm height is from the unverified listing data and is only an overall envelope estimate. It is not a measured value, and the board thickness is not stated. Hole positions and diameters were estimated from the dimensioned image scale, with the origin at the board center, +x along the length and +y toward the sensor edge. All hole values are approximate. The two rows of plated header holes at 2.54 mm pitch (about 1 mm holes, one square pad) are visible but not itemized, because their exact count and coordinates were not resolvable.
The 3 mm height is an unverified envelope. The 1.6 mm board thickness is assumed.
The sensors are simplified to plain boxes. Their size and Z position are estimated, and the row is shifted inward so it clears the corner holes.
The two rows of 2.54 mm header holes are omitted because their count and positions are not resolvable.
SMD components, pads and silkscreen are omitted.
The hole positions and diameters are approximate.
